title: Agent Execution Integrity Benchmark (AEIB) v0.2.4
description: The Agent Execution Integrity Benchmark (AEIB) v0.2.4 is a locally reproducible evaluation harness demonstrating that autonomous AI agents suffer duplicate mutations when suffering semantic drift during retry loops after a post-commit HTTP 504 transport severance. AEIB enforces a four-step boundary (state freeze, out-of-band authoritative probe, JCS + Ed25519 cryptographic receipt, and offline verification) to achieve zero observed duplicate debits across 50 deterministic fault trials. The release includes a versioned transport-to-disposition mapping contract, an explicit retry-policy vocabulary, a standalone offline verifier, and a live PostgreSQL 16 integration suite (4/4 passing). Status: locally executed and internally reproducible; external independent reproduction pending.
